identification: Mixed VFL card lot in 9 photos: pages of 1988 and 1991 Stimorol (red border, many North Melbourne), a page of 1970s Scanlens (about 1976-77), a page of 1960s Scanlens TV-shaped cards (about 1966-68, some trimmed or overlapped) and a page of 1969-70 style cut-out/die-cut footballers (Neale, Ferguson, Stewart, Lazarus, Watt, Allison, Dean, Teasdale, Ferry), apparently popped out. Mostly common; the 1960s pages are the best part. Price guides list regular 1968-69 commons around $4-8 each; popped die-cuts are worth less than unpopped.
